summary: PJM asks FERC to hold the paper hearing on its Reliability Backstop Procurement rules in abeyance while it prepares a new section 205 filing on cost allocation, Transmission Owner exit and LSE collateral.
ask: Hold the paper hearing proceedings and any additional briefing in ER26-3380 and EL26-108 in abeyance pending PJM's new section 205 filing.

points.point: PJM requests abeyance of the paper hearing pending a new section 205 filing responding to the September 29 Order.
points.quote: hold the paper hearing proceedings, including any additional briefings, in this docket in abeyance pending resolution of PJM’s forthcoming filing

points.point: The September 29 Order accepted the backstop rules but suspended them five months to review cost allocation, Transmission Owner exit rules and LSE collateral.
points.quote: suspended those rules for five months to allow time for further briefing through a paper hearing process to further review three discrete areas of the RBP: cost allocation, Transmission Owner exit rules, and LSE collateral requirements.

points.point: PJM plans to file the new section 205 proposal by October 29, 2026.
points.quote: a new FPA section 205 filing that addresses, inter alia, cost allocation issues, Transmission Owner exit responsibilities, and LSE collateral requirements as they relate to RBP by October 29, 2026.

throughLine.text: Schedule motion in PJM's backstop procurement dockets, which run beside E-7 and concern how PJM secures generation for new large loads, the subject of the E-7 adequacy report.
